title: fix(app-shell,plugin-chatbot): lay the pending-drafts bar out above the composer, not over it (objectui#12978)
body:
Fixes #12978

Clause-②: yes

## What changed

On the full-page AI build chat (`/ai/build`), with a pending draft, `ChatPane` floated `PendingDraftsBar` as a sibling of the chat column (`pointer-events-none absolute bottom-20`). That box sat on the composer's first input line, so the placeholder and the first typed line were hidden. The bar is now a row of the composer's own area, laid out in flow directly above the input: the conversation gives up the room instead, at every width.

- `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`: `ChatbotEnhanced` gains one optional prop, `promptHeaderSlot` (a `ReactNode`). It is rendered in flow at the top of the prompt area, above the input and outside its form, in a wrapper with `empty:hidden`, so content that renders nothing takes no space. A host that does not pass it renders exactly as before. README section added under "Surface chrome".
- `@object-ui/app-shell`: `ChatPane` hands the bar to `promptHeaderSlot` instead of floating it. Same condition as before (`isBuildSurface && !onBoundPackageStudio`), so the package's own Studio still draws no bar (objectui#12965 stands).
- The console dock mounts the same `ChatPane`, so it gets the same row; `layout/ChatDock.tsx` is not edited.

**Public face (Clause-②):** the delivered diff widens `ChatbotEnhancedProps` by the one optional prop `promptHeaderSlot`. No export is added or removed and no existing prop changes. The changeset bumps `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` minor and `@object-ui/app-shell` patch. The prop is not reachable from schema metadata: the `chatbot-enhanced` registration passes the node's props through `toDomProps` and names its schema keys one by one.

## Why a new prop: the two existing slots, measured

- `headerSlot` is in flow but sits above the conversation, at the top of the column, not by the composer.
- `promptOverlaySlot` is `absolute bottom-full` (meant for slash-command palettes). Handing the bar to it (a one-off edit, restored) clears the input, but in Chromium its box covers the bottom 54 px of the conversation's viewport (bar against the `role="log"` box: 648 by 54 at 1280), where the last message's tail, its action row and the scroll-to-bottom row sit. The in-flow row reads 0 there.

There was no in-flow place between the conversation and the input, so I added the narrowest one, as the dispatch allowed.

## Measured boxes (Acceptance 2)

Chromium headless, zh-CN, 900 px high (390 x 844 for the phone). The REAL full-page `AiChatPage` and the REAL `ChatDockPanel` with its real default body, served by the worktree's console Vite dev server, with `fetch` stubbed in the page: one `build` agent, two turns, and one draft for the bound package in `GET /api/v1/meta/_drafts`. "Before" puts the two edited files back to `main` at `50ba1bb`; "after" is the fix. Boxes are left top right bottom, in CSS px.

**Control:** `before-fullpage-1280` reproduces the card's live reading box for box (bar 401 766 1169 820, textarea 450 769 1120 833, 670 by 51, no first-line point on the input). So this harness puts the bar and the input exactly where the real page did.

| reading | bar | textarea | intersection (x by y, area) | first-line points on the input |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| full page 1280, before | 401 766 1169 820 | 450 769 1120 833 | 670 by 51, 34170 | 0 of 5 |
| full page 1280, after | 449 706 1121 760 | 450 769 1120 833 | 670 by 0, **0** | 5 of 5 |
| full page 1010, before | 305 766 994 820 | 315 769 985 833 | 670 by 51, 34170 | 0 of 5 |
| full page 1010, after | 314 706 986 760 | 315 769 985 833 | 670 by 0, **0** | 5 of 5 |
| dock 1280, before | 877 766 1264 820 | 862 769 1279 833 | 387 by 51, 19737 | 0 of 5 |
| dock 1280, after | 861 706 1280 760 | 862 769 1279 833 | 417 by 0, **0** | 5 of 5 |
| dock 1010, before | 607 766 994 820 | 592 769 1009 833 | 387 by 51, 19737 | 0 of 5 |
| dock 1010, after | 591 706 1010 760 | 592 769 1009 833 | 417 by 0, **0** | 5 of 5 |
| phone 390, before | 16 710 374 764 | 17 713 373 777 | 356 by 51, 18156 | 0 of 5 |
| phone 390, after | 16 650 374 704 | 17 713 373 777 | 356 by 0, **0** | 5 of 5 |

After the fix, the placeholder 「问问数据，或让我改改这个应用…」 (208 px) fits whole in its 646 px (full page) and 393 px (dock) content width, with the bar 9 px above the input. The textarea's own box does not move; the conversation's bottom moves from 768 to 706. With no draft, the textarea box and the conversation box are identical before and after (bottom 768): the empty slot takes no space. A 768 px reading is clean as well.

![after, full page, 1010](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/raw/baab26059420ee8386ed77f0aca664f8ab7e08df/evidence/12978/after-fullpage-1010.png)

After, console dock 1280 and 1010:

![after, dock, 1280](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/raw/baab26059420ee8386ed77f0aca664f8ab7e08df/evidence/12978/after-dock-1280.png)

**Where the evidence lives:** commit `baab260` of this branch, directory `evidence/12978/`. It holds every screenshot (before and after), each reading as JSON, the rig's README, the throwaway harness page and the Playwright driver. The next commit, `b24726f`, deletes the directory, so this pull request's diff does not carry it (`git rev-parse 8d6c70a^{tree} b24726f^{tree}` prints the same tree twice). No other branch was created.

## Tests (Acceptance 1 and 3)

- `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.draftsBarInFlow-12978.test.tsx` (new). It uses the real full-page `AiChatPage`, the real `ChatDockPanel` default body (the dock resolves the `build` agent itself), and the real `ChatPane`, `ChatbotEnhanced` and `PendingDraftsBar`, with one draft pending. happy-dom runs no layout, so comparing boxes there would pass whatever the layout was. The test reads the structure that decides the boxes instead: (1) the nearest element holding both the bar and the input does not hold the conversation (`role="log"`); (2) nothing between the bar and that element, or between the input and it, is out of flow (`absolute`, `fixed` or `sticky`, by class or inline style); (3) the bar's row comes before the input's row; (4) the bar is outside the input's form. Both cases (full page, dock) pass. The boxes themselves are the browser table above.
- `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.promptHeaderSlot-12978.test.tsx` (new) pins the prop's own contract: the same four readings, plus no row without the prop and no leak onto the DOM as an attribute.
- `AiChatPage.studioDraftsBar-12965.test.tsx`: its `ChatbotEnhanced` stub now draws `promptHeaderSlot`, so its Studio-absent and full-page/dock-present readings keep reading the bar.
- **Ablation:** I committed the fix, then put `AiChatPage.tsx` back to `50ba1bb` with the slot prop kept (trap-guarded). The `promptHeaderSlot=` anchor went from 1 to 0 on disk, and the new test went red in both cases (`Tests 2 failed (2)`), on exactly the old geometry: `holdsConversation: true` and `outOfFlow: ["div absolute"]`. The restore was proved by blob hash against HEAD and by `git diff HEAD` reading 0 lines.
- **Type face, reverse check:** the README snippet compiles `--strict` against the rebuilt `dist` typings (exit 0). A misspelled `promptHeaderSlotX` is refused with TS2322, and the compiler suggests `promptHeaderSlot`, so the rebuilt `.d.ts` was the one read.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`: `Test Files 1593 passed | 1 skipped (1594)`, `Tests 14897 passed | 9 skipped (14906)`, exit 0 (the AbortError traces in its stderr are happy-dom iframe teardown, not failures). `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot test`: `Test Files 79 passed (79)`, `Tests 772 passed (772)`, exit 0. Both ran on tree `987ea4f` (commit `8d6c70a`), which is also HEAD `b24726f`'s tree.

## Gates (local subset; the farm is CI's)

Each exit code was captured before any pipe. On `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`: `lint` 0 (warnings only, none in the changed files), `type-check` 0 (`tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes both new test files), `test` 0. Repo checks: `check:new-line-citations` 0 (`0 new citation(s)`), `check:control-bytes` 0, `check:vi-mock-specifiers` / `-inherit` / `-override-shape` 0, `check:test-path-roots` 0, `check:pending-changeset-literals` 0, `check:changeset-claims` 0, `check-changeset-presence.mjs` 0, and `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` 0.

Not fully measured locally:
- `check:readme-exports` exits 1 on a precondition: seven packages are unbuilt here (app-shell, cli, plugin-ai, plugin-gantt, plugin-map, plugin-markdown, plugin-timeline), and none of them is this README. `--list` judges the new snippet's self-imports `real`.
- `check:doc-snippets` was not run: it needs the whole doc build closure, so CI runs it. The new snippet was compiled by hand, as above.
- No i18n key or user-facing string is touched.

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of scope, reported for the seat: the phone preview pill covers the input.** At 390 x 844, after previewing a built app and closing the preview, `ai-chat-mobile-preview-open` (`absolute inset-x-0 bottom-24`, box 144 712 246 748) covers the textarea by 101 by 35, and the middle first-line point hits the pill. That reading is the same before and after this change. Before, the pill also sat on the bar (101 by 36); after, it does not touch the bar. Not changed here. Screenshots: `before-fullpage-390-pill.png` and `after-fullpage-390-pill.png` on `baab260`.
- `promptOverlaySlot` has no consumer anywhere in this repository; noted only.
- The dock readings use a stand-in console frame around the real `ChatDockPanel` (a 56 px header and a main area). The composer's geometry is the dock body's own, but the frame is not `ConsoleLayout`.
